 David Fincher’s ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’: First Reactions
 The standalone sequel to Quentin Tarantino's Oscar-winner 'Once Upon a Time in Hollywood' sees the return of Brad Pitt's movie stuntman, and also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Carla Gugino and Peter Weller.

 The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth , the buzzy, David Fincher -directed standalone sequel to Quentin Tarantino ‘s Once Upon a Time in Hollywood , held its premiere in Los Angeles on Monday evening and the first reactions have hit social media. 
 The embargo for full critics reviews for Cliff Booth is Nov. 19, but Netflix allowed some brief social media reaction to the film after its L.A. premiere. Cliff Booth is set to have a short, and very controversial, theatrical run , with the film being released exclusively in Imax cinemas on Nov. 25, before its Netflix streaming debut on Dec. 23.

 (L-R) Brad Pitt as Cliff Booth and Elizabeth Debicki as Karen Crosby in The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth 
 Courtesy of Netflix 
 Cliff Booth sees Brad Pitt return as the titular character, the effortlessly cool veteran Hollywood stuntman we saw in Once Upon a Time . In the sequel, we see Pitt’s character as now more a part-time stuntman who seems to be doing odd, and sometimes dangerous, jobs in 1977 Los Angeles. 
 The ensemble cast includes Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan , Yahya Abdul-Mateen II , Carla Gugino, Peter Weller , Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Corey Fogelmanis and Karren Karagulian.
 (L-R) Brad Pitt as Cliff Booth, Elizabeth Debicki as Karen Crosby, Scott Caan as Charlie Peters and Carla Gugino as Toni Becka in The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth 
 Courtesy of Netflix 
 Timothy Olyphant is the only other star from Once Upon a Time reprising his role, returning as Western actor James Stacy. At Monday evening’s premiere, Pitt explained why Once Upon a Time star Leonardo DiCaprio’s cameo as Rick Dalton in the sequel fell apart. 
 Released by Sony Pictures in 2019, and written and directed by Tarantino, Once Upon a Time was a huge commercial and critical success. The film made $410 million at the box office and was nominated for 10 Oscars, winning two — Pitt for best supporting actor and Barbara Ling and Nancy Haigh for production design. 
 (L-R) Brad Pitt as Cliff Booth and Peter Weller as Gus Booth in The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth 
 Courtesy of Netflix 
 Netflix purchased the script for Once Upon a Time ‘s sequel from Tarantino in 2025 and engaged Fincher to direct. Fincher previously revealed that Cliff Booth was almost developed as a Netflix series instead of a movie, as Tarantino’s original script was 230 pages long. Fincher ended up cutting 60 pages. 
 Despite handing over the directing duties to his friend Fincher, Tarantino has been involved in the promo for Cliff Booth. The Pulp Fiction filmmaker presented 17-minutes of the finished Cliff Booth at AFI Fest in late October and also explained his reasons for reviving Pitt’s character. Tarantino will also pen and release the novel, The Adventures of Cliff Booth , for Harper this December. 
 See social media reaction to The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth below. 
 David Fincher’s “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth” is a wild, hilarious hangout movie. Brad Pitt slides back into his beloved Oscar-winning role and gives his best performance since “Once Upon a Time in…Hollywood.” Elizabeth Debicki brings an intoxicating sensuality,… pic.twitter.com/Z4Ec0AWiAm 
— Clayton Davis (@ByClaytonDavis) November 17, 2026 
 THE FURTHER MISADVENTURES OF #CLIFFBOOTH is a pure riot. David Fincher’s play at a nostalgic bygone era Quentin Tarantino loves works like gangbusters. Takes time to form, but plays like a LA film noir hangout picture. Pitt & Debicki are electric together. Peter Weller, MVP. pic.twitter.com/njhxWdSm0f 
— Courtney Howard (@Lulamaybelle) November 17, 2026 
 THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH is my favorite movie of the year and it’s not even close. Hilarious, exciting, romantic, you’ll never guess what happens next and probably not believe it then anyway. Couldn’t love it more if I tried. pic.twitter.com/wcJmcnOJkU 
— Germain Lussier (@GermainLussier) November 17, 2026 
 the further mis-adventures of cliff booth is one of the best films of the year. genuinely so fun could have watched this ensemble for hours. cliff booth as a travis mcgee type of la cool guy, a dream. brad pitt is effortlessly perfect, mellow glow with a streak of violent love 💘 pic.twitter.com/z98sCa2zZY 
— kenzie xcx 🦋 (@kenzie__xcx) November 17, 2026 
 #TheFurtherMisAdventuresOfCliffBooth is a PURE cinematic trifecta of Tarantino’s signature chaos, Fincher’s meticulous attention to detail, and Brad Pitt’s effortlessly charismatic Cliff Booth.
All wrapped into a stylish love letter to 1970s Hollywood cinema that reminds us… pic.twitter.com/o3ysMan8F3 
— Zach Pope (@ZachhPope) November 17, 2026 
 Go see The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, It’s a F—-king brilliant film. Tarantino + Fincher are perfect partners in crime to deliver this, and they do it in spades. Inject the Trent and Atticus score into my blood. Need 2 c it again pic.twitter.com/qwuMvDLKem 
— Jazz Tangcay (@jazzt) November 17, 2026 
 Just watched The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth for a second time. Brad Pitt is effortlessly cool, and the movie is an absolute blast from beginning to end. I expect Elizabeth Debicki to win Best Actress. 
Highly recommended! #Netflix #BradPitt #QuentinTarantino pic.twitter.com/cKv9MkFFfo 
— 🎮🍿Pturtle 🐢🍿🎮 (@PturtIe) November 17, 2026 
 Absolutely loved #CliffBooth — Tarantino and Fincher are like peanut butter and chocolate (the peanut butter is profane and the chocolate dipped in blood). Stop watching anything, go see it on the biggest screen around, have the time of your life. An absolute triumph. The best. pic.twitter.com/6uUNnHPjyI 
— Drew Taylor (@DrewTailored) November 17, 2026 
 David Fincher’s The Further Mis-Adventures of #CliffBooth pops, throbs and crackles. Like Once Upon a Time… this is a love letter to LA. An eclectic, ragtag cast make this a slick and sexy romp. A salty and slower-burning side piece to Tarantino’s original with a fire final act. pic.twitter.com/3izap5l2wp 
— Simon Thompson (@ShowbizSimon) November 17, 2026 
 David Fincher cools down Tarantino with precision in THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH. A cynical neo-noir anchored by a superb, lethal Brad Pitt in full restraint: he no longer does stunts, he cleans up the filth of 1977 Hollywood. A brilliant, relentless auteur anomaly. pic.twitter.com/xD9ZYgqq2u 
— Jairo Jiménez (@jairojimenez_) November 17, 2026 
 Even with an expired ticket I loved seeing the premiere of: #TheFurtherMisadvenuresofCliffBooth !
Tarantino’s script was fantastic, Fincher’s direction was as cool as you’d expect + great performances to boot!
Can’t wait to read Tarantino’s novelization in Dec + see it again! pic.twitter.com/iMajKN8mxY 
— Jeff Goldsmith (@yogoldsmith) November 17, 2026 
 The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth is an absolute banger. An aesthetically rich film that beautifully captures the relationship between Los Angeles and the movies. Brad Pitt is as charismatic as ever. Truly one of the year’s best films.
— Ricky Vàlero (@rickyvalero_) November 17, 2026
